messages:
maria_support: Heads-up: Brightline reported a regression after last night's rollout to model-redwood-v3.2-rc. They say the assistant stopped invoking their `orders.getStatus` function reliably and sometimes calls unrelated functions like `billing.initiateRefund` with malformed args. Escalation opened at 03:55 UTC. :rotating_light:

maria_support: Rollout summary from deploy logs: model-redwood-v3.2-rc pushed to canary at 03:30 UTC, promoted to shared pool at 03:38 UTC. Brightline's errors start ~03:45 UTC.

maria_support: Customer repro (sanitized) was attached:
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
{
  "model": "model-redwood-v3.2-rc",
  "messages": [
    {"role":"system","content":"You must call the orders.getStatus function when asked about order status. Return only JSON function calls if applicable."},
    {"role":"user","content":"What's the status of order BL-77823?"}
  ],
  "functions": [
    {"name":"orders.getStatus","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"order_id":{"type":"string"}},"required":["order_id"]}},
    {"name":"billing.initiateRefund","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"order_id":{"type":"string"},"reason":{"type":"string"}},"required":["order_id","reason"]}}
  ],
  "function_call": "auto"
}
```

maria_support: Expected: assistant chooses `orders.getStatus` with args `{"order_id":"BL-77823"}`. Observed from Brightline (copy): assistant returned plain text "Your order shipped yesterday" or in some cases called `billing.initiateRefund` with args `{"order":"BL-77823"}` (wrong param name) leading to validation failure in their webhook.

jordan_oncall: Can you drop the x-request-id(s) and which region/org? Need logs +-30m.

maria_support: Provided ids: req-bright-2201, req-bright-2234. Region: us-west-2, org: brightline-prod. They are on shared-hosted plan. I'll DM raw headers.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: promotion model-redwood-v3.2-rc -> shared at 03:38 UTC. Canary logs show a spike of "function_call:decision mismatch" warnings at 03:36 UTC.

tom_eng_ml: Thanks. My initial suspicions: 1) we rolled a change to the system prompt that nudges the model toward more conversational answers; 2) there's a runtime optimization that dedupes very similar batched requests and may be reusing response objects incorrectly when functions list differs order — could cause wrong function names or arg keys.

tom_eng_ml: Does Brightline use stable ordering of functions? If they send functions in different orders, and we have an optimization that assumes canonical order, that might map indexes incorrectly.

maria_support: They said their code hasn't changed and functions are always the same order in the payload.

nora_research: I'll start a bisect. We had landed two changes this week: PR#3661 (tighter JSON-only guidance in system prompt) and runtime change RTE-1123 (batch response reuse for cold-start latency). Either or both interacting could explain text answers or wrong calls.

tom_eng_ml: Quick repro attempt from our side using hosted API with their sanitized payload. With single request we get correct `orders.getStatus`. Under load (25 concurrent identical sessions) on v3.2-rc I see ~8% plain text, ~4% wrong-function, and many wrong arg keys like `order` vs `order_id`. Switching to v3.1 fixed it in my local runs.

jordan_oncall: Mitigation options: 1) route org to v3.1 via per-org routing; 2) enforce `function_call: {"name":"orders.getStatus"}` on their route as a temporary shim; 3) block v3.2-rc promotion and roll back globally. Which is quickest?

maria_support: Brightline asked for a per-org fix. They do not want global rollback unless many customers impacted.

control-plane-bot: routing-change: created request to pin org "brightline-prod" -> model-redwood-v3.1. Ticket RC-5029.

nora_research: Bisect update: reverting PR#3661 (system prompt) reduces plain-text responses, reverting RTE-1123 (batch reuse) eliminates wrong-function mappings in stress tests. Looks like both changes combined under concurrency cause deletion/rename of arg keys during some serialization path.

tom_eng_ml: Repro steps I used: 1) spawn 40 parallel clients hitting same conversation with `function_call: auto`; 2) model v3.2-rc with RTE-1123 enabled; 3) observe ~12% deviation where response either is text or references a different function. 4) disable RTE-1123 -> mapping correct in 99.5% of cases.

jordan_oncall: Action plan:
- Immediate: pin brightline-prod to v3.1 (control-plane done). Notify customer we did this.
- Short term: revert RTE-1123 on shared pool and re-run canary with RTE-1123 disabled; add extra logging for function_call token streams.
- Medium: add a regression test that stress-tests function_call mappings with shuffled function lists and high QPS.

maria_support: Customer notified and acknowledged: "Pinning helps, thanks. Please keep us posted." They're asking for ETA for full fix.

nora_research: I've opened runtime PR #4988 to temporarily disable RTE-1123. Also adding telemetry points to log function index mapping and final chosen call. Will push canary later today.

tom_eng_ml: I'm drafting a lightweight validation shim we can apply at the API layer: if a function_call is returned and args don't match declared parameter names, we reject and retry with a forced `function_call.name` plus a templated args prompt. That buys time if runtime patch takes longer.

jordan_oncall: Sounds good. @nora_research coordinate with infra for canary. If canary validates, we schedule a limited rollout patch. If we see >3 orgs affected during analytics, escalate for global rollback.

maria_support: Added tags: escalation, regression, function_call, routing-pin. Will update incident tracker.

control-plane-bot: incident-tracker: created INC-2026-0422 for function_call mapping regression.

nora_research: Analytics request: can analytics pull rate of function_call vs plain-text and wrong-function per model version across last 6 hours so we can scope blast radius?

maria_support: Added to the ticket.

jordan_oncall: Keep this thread succinct. Next update when canary runs finish or brightline reports recurrence.

maria_support: Closing for now pending canary validation and analytics. Will reopen if customer sees further issues. :white_check_mark:
